description: 0000-CARDFILE-OPEN reports '23' - a record-not-found response from the OPEN - and the program abends before reading anything. app/cbl/CBACT02C.cbl:118-134 is deliberately two-armed: :121 tests CARDFILE-STATUS = '00' and every other status, '23' included, falls to :124 MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT. There is no APPL-EOF arm in the open paragraph - that exists only in the read paragraph at :107 - so the guard at :126 takes its ELSE and the three-statement error arm runs in source order: DISPLAY 'ERROR OPENING CARDFILE' at :129, MOVE CARDFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS at :130, PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS at :131 which emits the numeric-arm image '0023' (:170-172, '0000' overlaid at position three by the two status characters), and PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM at :132 which DISPLAYs 'ABENDING PROGRAM' at :155 and CALLs 'CEE3ABD' at :158. RETURN-CODE is the 12 the guard chain put in APPL-RESULT. The whole card master is seeded, and not one row of it is read: a dataset can exist and still refuse to open.
